what: S1 test sequences for Powerlines (NEXT.md S1): the offset section along each of the last two lines, and the block opening along the cooling pond. Tests at 30 fps, 1920x1080; not the film.

files.S1-section-dniprovska.mp4: the offset section: the cooling pond's north dike (x = -3000 m on the crossing's grid, south to north, seen from the east), a break where the cut jogs about 6.7 km east, then along Dniprovska's crossing (towers 21-27); 18.7 s
files.S1-section-ferosplavna.mp4: the same with Ferosplavna's crossing (its row carries both circuits; towers 18-26); the jog about 6.3 km; 18.7 s
files.S1-block-opening.mp4: the region as one block at true size, heights grown to x25, opened 2.5 km along the pond's cut, then the three days; 35.5 s
files.stills/: the offset sections as wide stills (3126 px), each day
files.scripts/: the scripts as run (Blender 5.2 headless, then PIL and ffmpeg); states.json the days, levels and captions

A.why: island mode, 5-10 September 2022: every line cut, unit 6 powering the plant (the record, config/conductive-seam.yaml)
A.imagery: Sentinel-2 L2A, 29 August 2022 08:36 UTC (6 and 8 September clouded over, said on screen)
A.levels: the reservoir and the pond at the reservoir's normal level, 16 m Baltic (its design level); the level that day not published

B.why: the month on diesel generators, 23 September - 23 October 2025: no line connected (the record)
B.levels: pond 13.54 m Baltic (Energoatom via OECD-NEA, 11 August 2025, the last report before); river at the crossing 7.26 m (SWOT, monthly, via bed.series)

C.why: 18 days on diesel generators, 20 August - 7 September 2026: no line connected (the record)
C.levels: pond 12.34 m Baltic (Ukraine's HUR, 1 October 2026, unverified: the nearest report, after the day); river 7.74 m (SWOT, monthly)

the_12_m_line: the pond's reported lower limit for the cooling water pumps; the IAEA's own wording still to be checked (NEXT.md S1)
drawn: every height x10 in the sections (ground, water, towers, sag: the plan-and-profile convention), lengths true; the detail at three times the section's scale, heights still x10
in the block: ground and water x25, towers and sag at true size on the exaggerated ground
the water a modelled surface at the reported level, where each day's pass reads water; in the pond, where the pass reads no water it is drawn dry (shoals or plants)
the drained bed's heights inferred (the waterline method, scene3d/bed.py), dotted on the cuts; the pond's depth not published, faded
towers at OpenStreetMap's positions, types representative (the 3D film's models, towers.npz); every wire bare steel: each day a complete loss of off-site power, chosen so
a dissolve mixes two days' drawings and says it is not an observation; nothing is generated
safety: no tower marked, numbered or pinned; the key plan shows only the cut and its jog; no coordinates on screen
sources: Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A via Microsoft Planetary Computer
FABDEM heights and the bed's inferred heights (bed.json)
SWOT and gauges for the river (bed.series)
the record in config/conductive-seam.yaml (the IAEA's updates via WNA and OECD-NEA, Energoatom)
